verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs say you can target specific individuals and segments for a flag, and set expiration dates on that targeting. That covers the allowlist, beta-tester and internal-account part of the story. The evidence never explicitly documents excluding specific individuals, and individual targeting is mostly shown by doc titles with little detail on how it works. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding individual users from a flag, in-depth individual-targeting docs, independent hands-on corroboration of per-user targeting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: In addition to targeting specific context attributes, you can target individuals, segments, or specific mobile apps and devices.
Create as many feature flags as you need and target them by user, segment, or rule.
You can even set expiration dates for flag targeting if you know you only want customers to receive a flag for a specific period of time.
